summary: Local-embedding semantic retrieval shipped. transformers.js (@xenova/transformers 2.17.2) + all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384-dim ONNX) VERIFIED working in Node v23.9. Files: lib/embed.js (new: lazy-cached embed()->384 floats|null, never throws; cosine()); lib/overlay.js (addNoteNode stores vec); daemon.js (knowledgeText helper ~L455; embed import L19; embed-on-write in /overlay/note L1255 + /overlay/knowledge L1198; buildGraph note nodes expose vec L657; HYBRID /search rewrite L893-947 — semantic cosine primary, per-item lexical fallback, also folds in Tier-2 knowledge items; new POST /overlay/backfill-embeddings route); scripts/bench-arm.js (--consult=dagrag arm: DAG get_task_detail + search_knowledge); test/embed.test.js (new, 13 pass); .gitignore (models/); package.json (optionalDependencies). TESTS: embed.test 13/13; ALL 20 unit-test files pass (autowire15 benchmark19 git31 measure29 optimize31 bench-report61 etc.), 0 failures. Smoke: 72 pass / 11 fail — the 11 are PRE-EXISTING (identical on stashed original code; git-worktree fixture errors, unrelated). DISCRIMINATING CASE verified live: query 'why are users logged out unexpectedly after a while' vs note A 'session credential lifetime / JWT bearer short validity...' (relevant, diff words) and note B 'arcade machine token jam / coin token... after a while' (lexical-overlap, irrelevant): LEXICAL relevant=0.000 distractor=0.167 (mis-ranks), SEMANTIC relevant=0.356 distractor=0.268 (correct). End-to-end against live isolated daemon: note A 0.341 via:semantic outranks note B 0.210; 384-dim vec persisted in overlay JSON. DAEMON RESTART REQUIRED to activate (new routes/handlers). After restart, POST /overlay/backfill-embeddings once to embed existing notes/knowledge. Did NOT restart live daemon.
